_comment_why: Re-enable Chromium HttpsUpgrades feature, which @playwright/mcp hardcodes off via chromiumSwitches.ts. Required for SAP Splunk DCs (dc22/25/33/34/52/55/80/81/82/84) where the server returns Location: http://... and the browser otherwise obeys the downgrade and stalls on firewalled port 80.
_comment_how: Playwright's ignoreDefaultArgs uses exact-string match against launch args. We list the full default --disable-features string verbatim to drop it, then re-add it via args without HttpsUpgrades.
_comment_fragility: If @playwright/mcp upgrades and changes any feature in the disable list (added, removed, renamed, reordered), the exact-match below will silently fail and HttpsUpgrades returns to disabled. Pin @playwright/mcp version, OR add a runtime check that greps the actual launched browser args.
